item.description:
### Fixed - **A phone you wiped or lost no longer keeps your terminal waiting.** If a paired phone stopped connecting without being unpaired, Perch still held every unanswered approval for the phone's 45-second window for two weeks. Now a phone that has not connected in two days, or whose notifications Apple reports as undeliverable, still gets its pushes but no longer holds the terminal; the prompt appears there after the usual 22 seconds.
### Added - **Claude Code's newer hook events.** Perch now listens for a tool failing (the session's activity line says so instead of showing the last tool), the working directory changing mid-session (the project label follows), and tasks being created or completed (the checklist updates at once instead of on the next event). Existing installs pick these up on the next launch; nothing changes on a Claude Code version that does not send them.
